description: Pin or unpin pages on one of the signed-in person's sites. Pinned pages are scanned in every site scan of that site and count toward its score; up to 25, on the site itself. Give pin and/or unpin lists. Returns each address's outcome and the pins now in place; they apply from the next scan.

host.description: The site, as list_sites gives it.

pin.description: Page addresses to pin. They must be on the site (or its www/apex twin).
